text.p: These are the headlines from selected Canadian newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Ontario seeks quicker justice: Panel to consider ending preliminary hearings, limiting witnesses' time on stand.
- Chetien begins diplomatic round: Summit in Denver precedes UN visit.
- Burger chain wins McLibel suit: Environmentalists ordered to pay 60,000 British pounds for defamatory leaflets.
- British Tories pick Hague by unexpected margin: Youngest leader since 1783 calls for end to factions.
- Patten chides China in legislature farewell: 'Decolonization' of Hong Kong called unique in its damage to democracy.
- Maple Leaf lyrics not quite forever.
- Deal creates aero heavyweight: Once-troubled Magellan Aerospace 4th in field with C$62.5-million acquisition of Bristol.
- Cineplex ponders merger with Sony unit: 'Good synergies' seen in theatre deal.
- Consumer buying 'frenzy' driving economic expansion: Retail sales, imports pick up slack left by weaker exports.
- B.C. forest industry backs jobs plan: But stresses NDP must keep promises.
- Cineplex, Loews in talks: Proposed merger would give Sony 50 percent of combined theatre chain with Bronfmans' Universal Studios and Seagram retaining minority stakes.
- Magellan Aerospace snaps up Winnipeg's Bristol for C$62.5 million.
